metadata.title: Pragmatic Professional Seed: Ready-to-Work Standards
metadata.notes: High-demand certifications for immediate employment today.

nodes.title: OSHA Forklift Operator Certification
nodes.description: Safe operation of powered industrial trucks. Pre-operation inspection, load handling, and maneuverability. Linked to the Warehouse Vector track.

nodes.title: Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED
nodes.description: Professional emergency response. Recognizing signs of heart attack, stroke, and choking. Performing high-quality CPR and using an AED.

nodes.title: Google Cloud Digital Leader
nodes.description: Distinguishing cloud computing from traditional IT. Business value of Google Cloud. Linked to the Architecture of Agency track.

nodes.title: Intuit QuickBooks Certified User
nodes.description: Professional SME bookkeeping. Invoicing, expenses, payroll, and financial reports. Mapping the TEND economy to standard financial software.

nodes.title: Microsoft Office Specialist: Excel Associate
nodes.description: Professional spreadsheet management. Creating formulas, managing data, and visualizing results. Essential for all guild-operations.

edges.rationale: Warehouse stewardship capstone provides the environment-awareness needed for forklift safety.
Sovereign emergency care mastery covers 90% of the Red Cross professional certification syllabus.
Mutual credit bookkeeping training provides the systemic foundation for professional QuickBooks use.
